design-system.label: Design system
design-system.what: The brand's rules for building: color, type, logo, layouts, modules.
design-system.when: Open it before you start any piece for the brand.

deliverables.label: Deliverables hub
deliverables.what: Every finished job for the client, grouped by channel, ready for review.
deliverables.when: Send this link to the client or team. Each new job lands here.

library.label: Asset library
library.what: Photos, tokens or modules pulled from approved work, with paths and rights.
library.when: Search here before you crop, shoot or rebuild an asset.

studio.label: Studio
studio.what: A working tool paired with a Claude Project: the team makes pieces in the Project and turns them into final files here.
studio.when: Open it to render and download what the Project hands over.

board.label: Review board
board.what: A working page for one campaign or one decision while it is in production.
board.when: Use it during the job. When the job ships, it moves into the deliverables hub.
